next: Record and replay a compliant two-minute camera + accelerometer + gyroscope session on a real phone.
Complete the Day 7 temporal and day/night lane-quality review.

Benchmark end-to-end FPS (not model-only) on CPU, iGPU and GPU with scripts/bench_inference.py and run_road_benchmarks.py.

benchmarks.note: Measured 2026-11-11 on an Intel Core 5 210H laptop (Intel iGPU + RTX 4050) with scripts/bench_inference.py: batch 1, model call only (no decode, NMS or rendering), best thread count shown. *INT8 used random calibration, so only its speed is meaningful. YOLOX-S CPU rows omitted (noisy run). Not phone evidence and not end-to-end FPS.

decisions.decision: Custom JPEG HTTPS POST + batched JSON telemetry (documented deviation from MJPEG/RTSP/WebRTC).
YOLOP is the default lane candidate; the classical fitter stays as the interpretable baseline.
YOLOX-Tiny (Apache-2.0) selected over YOLOX-Nano for accuracy; RT-DETR/D-FINE/RF-DETR (Apache-2.0) are the next candidates. Ultralytics YOLO is AGPL-3.0 and needs a licence review before use.
Depth Anything V2 Small (Apache-2.0) relative and metric outputs kept separate and labelled; neither is validated distance.
person, rider, car, truck, bus, two-wheeler, traffic sign, traffic light + lane head; 'obstacle' is open-set (depth/free-space), not a box class.
Public-data results are not phone evidence; model-only FPS is never reported as end-to-end FPS; missing sensors are never invented.
